rules.statement: The words in a deed are to be construed most strongly against the person who uses them, if so doing works no wrong.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is a maxime in law, that every man's grant shall be taken by construction of law most forcible against himself. Quaelibet conce8sio fortissimo contra donatorem interpretanda, which is so to be understood, that no wrong be thereby done; for it is another maxime in law, Quod legis constructio non facit injuriam."
